subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close or replace the open conflicting cross-repo PR before allowing a new narrow fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug shape is clear, but GitHub still has an open closing PR for this issue and the issue carries linked-pr/no-new-fix-pr routing, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers resolve that candidate.

options.title: Retire candidate and queue a narrow fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting cross-repo PR, then allow a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt manually
options.body: A maintainer can hand-port the useful final-action split from the closed same-repo PR and handle proof or Mantis validation directly.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Leave the issue open with the current linked PR while waiting for the fork author to rebase onto the active runtime path and add proof.

recommendation.title: Retire candidate and queue a narrow fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting cross-repo PR, then allow a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current native approval lifecycle and are the clearest routing owner for deciding whether to replace the obsolete handler-path candidate.
